cards.front: Recall a key point about Atomic Structure and Bonding
cards.back: Atomic structure: p⁺, n⁰, e⁻; isotopes = same Z, different A; electron config: 1s^22s^22p⁶...

cards.front: Recall a key point about Atomic Structure and Bonding
cards.back: Ionisation energy: increases across period (↑Z_eff), decreases down group (↑shielding, ↑n)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Atomic Structure and Bonding
cards.back: Ionic: metal + non-metal, electron transfer, lattice; Covalent: non-metal + non-metal, sharing

cards.front: Recall a key point about Atomic Structure and Bonding
cards.back: Electronegativity (Pauling): increases across, decreases down; >1.7 ionic, <0.4 non-polar covalent

cards.front: Recall a key point about Atomic Structure and Bonding
cards.back: VSEPR: electron pairs repel; 2bp -> linear, 3bp -> trigonal planar, 4bp -> tetrahedral, lone pairs reduce angles

cards.front: Recall a key point about Atomic Structure and Bonding
cards.back: IMFs: London (all molecules, ∝ electrons), dipole-dipole (polar), H-bonding (H on N,O,F)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Atomic Structure and Bonding
cards.back: Properties: Giant ionic/covalent/metallic -> high MP; Simple molecular -> low MP; H-bonding -> higher MP/BP
